sourceProfileNote.heading: Confined

source.pageConvention: one-based PDF; printed coordinates follow source authority ledger

sourceProfileNote.interpretation: Opening the Prison Bottle while exposing Confined Hoopa produces Unbound for three days, followed by three days of bottle cooldown. Destroying the bottle leaves Unbound until resealing with a new bottle. Unbound has persistent incurable Enraged and three stated substitutions: Hyperspace Hole→Hyperspace Fury, Shadow Ball→Dark Pulse, Phantom Force→Knock Off. These conditions are independent of a static species record.
